content_sections.heading: About the Mayiladuthurai Juvenile Justice Board Recruitment
content_sections.text: The notice is a press release issued on 03-11-2026 by the Public Relations Officer, Mayiladuthurai, for the district administration. It invites applications from eligible persons for appointment as Social Work Members of the Juvenile Justice Board constituted in Mayiladuthurai district under the rules of the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015. The notice states that the District Collector, H.S. Srikanth, I.A.S., has said the government's decision on this is final.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives one set of conditions for both posts. One of the two posts is for a woman. Age: applicants must be not less than 35 years and must not have completed 65 years, counted on the date the press release was published. No age relaxation is mentioned. Candidates should refer to the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

rows.eligibility: Involved with dedication for at least 7 years in health, education or welfare work related to children, OR a practising professional with a degree in child psychology, psychiatry, sociology or law.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The Social Work Members will be appointed on honorarium basis by the government. The notice states that the post is not a government service. The honorarium amount and the length of the term are not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Mayiladuthurai Juvenile Justice Board Social Work Members
content_sections.text: Obtain the application form from the District Child Protection Unit of the district, or download it from the department website https://dsdcpimms.tn.gov.in . Fill in the prescribed form. Send the completed form so that it reaches the Director, Department of Child Welfare and Special Services, No. 1A, First Floor, CMDA-II, Gandhi Irwin Road, Egmore, Chennai-600 008, by 5.00 PM on 3 December 2026. The notice names no documents to enclose and does not say how the form is to be sent.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice states that appointment will be based on qualification and experience. It does not describe any test or interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Completed applications must reach the Chennai office within the stated period. The two posts include one for a woman. The appointment is on honorarium basis and is not a government service.

faq.question: Q1. How many Social Work Member posts are there in Mayiladuthurai?
faq.answer: There are 2 Social Work Member posts on the Juvenile Justice Board, and they include one woman.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach the Chennai office by 5.00 PM on 3 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Social Work Member?
faq.answer: Applicants need at least 7 years of dedicated involvement in child-related health, education or welfare work. Alternatively, they must be practising professionals with a degree in child psychology, psychiatry, sociology or law.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Applicants must be not less than 35 years and must not have completed 65 years on the date the press release was published.

faq.question: Q5. Where is the application form available?
faq.answer: The form is available from the District Child Protection Unit of the district and on the department website https://dsdcpimms.tn.gov.in.

faq.question: Q6. Where should the application be sent?
faq.answer: It should be sent to the Director, Department of Child Welfare and Special Services, No. 1A, First Floor, CMDA-II, Gandhi Irwin Road, Egmore, Chennai-600 008.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a government job?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the Social Work Members are appointed on honorarium basis and the post is not a government service.

faq.question: Q8. How will the Social Work Members be selected?
faq.answer: The notice states that appointment will be based on qualification and experience.
